newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: IWP says finalises $100 mln private placement.
newsitem.headline: IWP says finalises $100 mln private placement.

text.p: IWP International Plc said on Friday that it had finalised a $100 million private placement which was raised partly to fund the acquisition of 80 percent of Constance Carroll Holdings Ltd.
IWP, which announced 1996 a 3.6 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 22.4 million punts, also said it was taking an 80 percent stake in Constance Carroll for 38 million sterling.
The placement comprises of senior unsecured notes which mature in 2007 on a bullet repayment basis, IWP said in a statement.
It said the funds were raised by Ulster Bank Markets as co-agent with NatWest Markets in New York who arranged the placement of the funds with a group of U.S. investors at a coupon of 7.73 percent.
IWP said this form of financing was competitively priced and has been swapped back into Euro currencies by IWP through Ulster Bank Markets to match fund its existing investment programme.

"This was the largest debt financing raised by IWP to date and its completion on very satisfactory terms is an endorsement of the company's financial standing and prospects by sophisticated long term U.S. investors," chief executive Joe Moran said.
